s.t: A poor father and mother lived near a forest.
s.fr: Un père et une mère pauvres vivaient près d’une forêt.

s.t: The father and mother had three sons.
s.fr: Le père et la mère avaient trois fils.

s.t: The eldest son and the second son could work.
s.fr: L’aîné et le deuxième fils pouvaient travailler.

s.t: The youngest son was kind.
s.fr: Le fils le plus jeune était gentil.

s.t: His brothers called him a simpleton.
s.fr: Ses frères l’appelaient un simplet.

paras.summary: A poor father and mother have three sons: a hardworking eldest son and second son, and a kind youngest son whom his older brothers call a simpleton.

s.t: But the youngest son did not mind.
s.fr: Mais le fils le plus jeune ne s’en souciait pas.

s.t: He shared what little he had.
s.fr: Il partageait le peu qu’il avait.

s.t: The father let his sons go into the forest.
s.fr: Le père laissa ses fils aller dans la forêt.

s.t: They cut wood there to earn money.
s.fr: Ils y coupaient du bois pour gagner de l’argent.

s.t: One day, the eldest son wanted to go first.
s.fr: Un jour, l’aîné voulut partir en premier.

paras.summary: The youngest son does not mind and shares what little he has, and since the family has little money, the father lets his sons go into the forest to cut wood and earn money, and one day the eldest son wants to go first.

s.t: The eldest son wanted wood to earn money for his mother.
s.fr: Le fils aîné voulait du bois pour gagner de l’argent pour sa mère.

s.t: The mother baked a cake for the eldest son.
s.fr: La mère prépara un gâteau pour le fils aîné.

s.t: She gave him a cup of sweet milk too.
s.fr: Elle lui donna aussi une tasse de lait sucré.

s.t: The eldest son walked into the forest with an axe.
s.fr: Le fils aîné marcha dans la forêt avec une hache.

s.t: He cut wood near a tree.
s.fr: Il coupa du bois près d’un arbre.

paras.summary: The eldest son wants wood to earn money for his mother, who bakes him a cake and sweet milk, and he walks into the forest with an axe and cuts wood near a tree.

s.t: Then a gray man came out of the trees.
s.fr: Puis un homme gris sortit des arbres.

s.t: "May I have some cake and milk?" the gray man asked.
s.fr: « Puis-je avoir du gâteau et du lait ? » demanda l’homme gris.

s.t: "No," said the eldest son.
s.fr: « Non, » dit le fils aîné.

s.t: The eldest son ate the cake alone and was not kind.
s.fr: Le fils aîné mangea le gâteau seul et ne fut pas généreux.

paras.summary: A gray man, who also walks alone in the forest, comes out of the trees and asks for some of his cake and milk, but the eldest son refuses, eats the cake alone, and is not kind.

s.t: He picked up his axe again.
s.fr: Il ramassa sa hache de nouveau.

s.t: The axe slipped and cut his arm.
s.fr: La hache glissa et lui coupa le bras.

s.t: The eldest son could not work with a cut arm.
s.fr: L’aîné ne pouvait pas travailler avec un bras blessé.

s.t: He walked home with no cake or wood for his mother.
s.fr: Il rentra chez lui sans gâteau ni bois pour sa mère.

paras.summary: He picks up his axe again, but it slips and cuts his arm, so he cannot work and walks home with no cake or wood for his mother.

s.t: The mother worried about her sons in the forest.
s.fr: La mère s’inquiétait de ses fils dans la forêt.

s.t: The mother baked a cake for the second son too.
s.fr: La mère cuisit un gâteau pour le deuxième fils aussi.

s.t: The second son walked into the forest with an axe.
s.fr: Le deuxième fils entra dans la forêt avec une hache.

paras.summary: The mother worries about her sons in the forest as she bakes the second son a cake and gives him milk, and he walks into the forest with an axe and cuts wood near a tree.

s.t: The same gray man came out of the trees.
s.fr: Le même homme gris sortit des arbres.

s.t: "May I have some cake and milk?" the gray man asked.
s.fr: « Puis-je avoir du gâteau et du lait ? » demanda l’homme gris.

s.t: "No," said the second son.
s.fr: « Non, » dit le deuxième fils.

s.t: The second son ate the cake alone.
s.fr: Le deuxième fils mangea le gâteau seul.

paras.summary: The same gray man asks to share his cake, but the second son refuses and eats alone.

s.t: He stood up and picked up his axe again.
s.fr: Il se leva et reprit sa hache.

s.t: The axe slipped and cut his leg.
s.fr: La hache glissa et coupa sa jambe.

s.t: The second son could not walk with a cut leg.
s.fr: Le deuxième fils ne pouvait pas marcher avec une jambe coupée.

s.t: His leg hurt, and he walked home without wood.
s.fr: Sa jambe lui faisait mal, et il rentra chez lui sans bois.

paras.summary: He picks up his axe again, but it slips and cuts his leg, so he cannot walk, and with his leg hurting, he walks home without wood.

s.t: Both brothers came home hurt from the forest.
s.fr: Les deux frères rentrèrent blessés de la forêt.

s.t: The father feared for his youngest son's safety.
s.fr: Le père craignait pour la sécurité de son fils le plus jeune.

paras.summary: Both brothers come home hurt, and the father, fearing for his youngest son's safety, remembers that his other two sons were hurt.

s.t: "The forest is not safe," the father said.
s.fr: « La forêt n’est pas sûre, » dit le père.

s.t: But the youngest son wanted to try too.
s.fr: Mais le fils le plus jeune voulait essayer aussi.

s.t: "Please let me go," he said.
s.fr: « Laissez-moi partir, je vous en prie. » dit-il.

s.t: The father let him go.
s.fr: Le père le laissa partir.

paras.summary: The father does not want the youngest son to go into the forest, but the youngest son asks to try, and the father finally lets him go.

s.t: The mother had little left to give him.
s.fr: La mère avait peu de choses à lui donner.

s.t: She baked a dry cake for him.
s.fr: Elle lui fit un gâteau sec.

s.t: She gave him a cup of sour milk too.
s.fr: Elle lui donna aussi une tasse de lait aigre.

s.t: The youngest son thanked his mother for the poor meal.
s.fr: Le fils cadet remercia sa mère pour le mauvais repas.

s.t: He walked toward the forest with the cake and milk.
s.fr: Il marcha vers la forêt avec le gâteau et le lait.

paras.summary: The mother has little left to give him, so she bakes a dry cake and gives him sour milk, and he thanks her and walks toward the forest with the food.

chapterList.title: Sharing in the Forest
also: The Inn and the Three Daughters

s.t: But the youngest son wanted to help his family.
s.fr: Mais le fils cadet voulait aider sa famille.

s.t: The same gray man came out of the trees.
s.fr: Le même homme gris sortit des arbres.

paras.summary: The youngest son walks into the forest, remembering that his brothers came home hurt, but he still wants to help his family, and the same gray man appears from the trees.

s.t: "May I share your cake and milk?" the gray man asked.
s.fr: « Puis-je partager votre gâteau et votre lait ? » demanda l’homme gris.

s.t: "Yes, please share my meal," said the youngest son.
s.fr: « Oui, partagez mon repas, je vous en prie, » dit-il, le fils cadet.

s.t: He gave the gray man the dry cake.
s.fr: Il donna à l’homme gris le gâteau sec.

s.t: He gave him the cup of sour milk too.
s.fr: Il lui donna aussi la tasse de lait aigre.

paras.summary: The gray man asks to share his cake and milk, and the youngest son happily agrees, giving him the dry cake and the cup of sour milk.

s.t: The dry cake became a soft cake.
s.fr: Le gâteau sec devint un gâteau mou.

s.t: The sour milk became sweet milk too.
s.fr: Le lait aigre devint aussi du lait doux.

s.t: The gray man and the youngest son ate together.
s.fr: L’homme gris et le fils cadet mangèrent ensemble.

s.t: "I will help you too," the gray man said.
s.fr: « Je vais vous aider aussi, » dit l’homme gris.

paras.summary: The dry cake becomes a soft cake and the sour milk becomes sweet milk; the gray man and the youngest son eat together and smile, the youngest son is happy, and the gray man thanks him and promises to help him too.

s.t: "Cut down that tree by the rock," said the gray man.
s.fr: « Coupez cet arbre près du rocher, » dit l’homme gris.

s.t: "Look among its roots," the gray man said.
s.fr: « Regardez parmi ses racines, » dit l’homme gris.

s.t: He found the tree by the rock.
s.fr: Il trouva l’arbre près du rocher.

paras.summary: The gray man tells the youngest son to cut down a certain tree by a rock and look among its roots, and the youngest son, still in the forest, finds the tree.

s.t: He cut down the tree with his axe.
s.fr: Il coupa l’arbre avec sa hache.

s.t: The tree fell down.
s.fr: L’arbre tomba.

s.t: He looked among its roots.
s.fr: Il chercha parmi ses racines.

s.t: A goose sat there with golden feathers.
s.fr: Une oie était là avec des plumes dorées.

paras.summary: He cuts down the tree, and among its roots he finds a goose with golden feathers.

s.t: The youngest son picked up the goose.
s.fr: Le fils cadet ramassa l’oie.

s.t: The youngest son put the goose under his arm.
s.fr: Le fils cadet mit l’oie sous son bras.

s.t: He thanked the gray man for his help.
s.fr: Il remercia l’homme gris pour son aide.

s.t: The gray man went back into the trees.
s.fr: L’homme gris retourna dans les arbres.

paras.summary: The youngest son picks up the goose and realizes he no longer has to earn money by cutting wood; this poor family now has a golden goose, and he puts it under his arm, thanks the gray man, and the gray man goes back into the trees.

s.t: That night, the youngest son came to an inn.
s.fr: Cette nuit-là, le fils cadet arriva à une auberge.

s.t: An innkeeper lived there with his three daughters.
s.fr: Un aubergiste vivait là avec ses trois filles.

s.t: "May I stay for the night?" the youngest son asked.
s.fr: « Puis-je rester pour la nuit ? » demanda le fils cadet.

s.t: "Yes, you may," said the innkeeper.
s.fr: « Oui, vous pouvez, » dit l’aubergiste.

paras.summary: That night the youngest son comes to an inn run by an innkeeper with three daughters, and the innkeeper lets him stay the night.

s.t: The three daughters saw the golden goose under his arm.
s.fr: Les trois filles virent l’oie dorée sous son bras.

s.t: The daughters wanted a golden feather too.
s.fr: Les filles voulaient une plume dorée aussi.

s.t: The first daughter said, "I will take a feather."
s.fr: La première fille dit, « Je vais prendre une plume. »

s.t: "Wait for him to fall asleep," said the second daughter.
s.fr: « Attends qu’il s’endorme, » dit la deuxième fille.

s.t: The third daughter wanted to try it too.
s.fr: La troisième fille voulait essayer aussi.

paras.summary: The three daughters see the golden goose and want a feather too, so they plan to take one once the young man falls asleep.

s.t: The youngest son ate some food and went to bed.
s.fr: Le fils cadet mangea de la nourriture et alla se coucher.

s.t: He put the golden goose in his room.
s.fr: Il mit l’oie dorée dans sa chambre.

s.t: He fell asleep.
s.fr: Il s’endormit.

paras.summary: The youngest son eats, puts the goose in his room, and falls asleep.

s.t: Later that night, the first daughter went to his room.
s.fr: Plus tard cette nuit-là, la première fille alla dans sa chambre.

s.t: The first daughter reached out and pulled at a golden feather.
s.fr: La première fille tendit la main et tira sur une plume dorée.

s.t: Her hand stuck fast to the goose.
s.fr: Sa main resta collée à l’oie.

paras.summary: Later that night the first daughter goes to his room and pulls at a golden feather, but her hand sticks fast to the goose and she cannot pull free.

s.t: She called quietly for her sister.
s.fr: Elle appela doucement sa sœur.

s.t: The second daughter came to help her.
s.fr: La deuxième fille vint l’aider.

s.t: She took hold of her sister's arm.
s.fr: Elle saisit le bras de sa sœur.

s.t: Her hand stuck fast to her sister's arm too.
s.fr: Sa main resta collée au bras de sa sœur aussi.

paras.summary: She calls quietly for her sister, who comes to help and grabs her arm, but her hand sticks fast too.

s.t: Both daughters called for the third daughter, who came to help.
s.fr: Les deux filles appelèrent la troisième fille, qui vint les aider.

s.t: She took hold of the second daughter's hand.
s.fr: Elle saisit la main de la deuxième fille.

s.t: She stuck fast too.
s.fr: Elle resta collée aussi.

s.t: But the golden goose and the youngest son did not wake up.
s.fr: Mais l’oie dorée et le fils cadet ne se réveillèrent pas.

s.t: All three daughters stood stuck together in a line.
s.fr: Les trois filles restèrent collées ensemble en ligne.

paras.summary: The third daughter comes to help as well and sticks fast too, and though the golden goose and the youngest son do not wake up, all three daughters now stand stuck together in a line.

s.t: The youngest son woke up.
s.fr: Le fils cadet se réveilla.

s.t: He did not mind the three daughters.
s.fr: Il ne fit pas attention aux trois filles.

s.t: He picked up the golden goose and held it under his arm.
s.fr: Il ramassa l’oie dorée et la tint sous son bras.

s.t: He left the inn with the goose.
s.fr: Il quitta l’auberge avec l’oie.

paras.summary: In the morning the youngest son wakes, pays the three daughters no mind, picks up the goose, and leaves the inn with it.

s.t: The youngest son walked down the road toward the city.
s.fr: Le fils cadet marcha sur la route vers la ville.

s.t: The three daughters ran behind the goose.
s.fr: Les trois filles coururent derrière l’oie.

paras.summary: The three daughters, still stuck fast to the goose, must run behind as he walks down the road toward the city.

s.t: "Stop!" the first daughter called out.
s.fr: « Arrêtez ! » cria la première fille.

s.t: "Wait for us!" she said.
s.fr: « Attendez-nous ! » dit-elle.

s.t: But the youngest son did not stop.
s.fr: Mais le fils cadet ne s’arrêta pas.

s.t: The three daughters ran after him in a field.
s.fr: Les trois filles coururent après lui dans un champ.

paras.summary: The first daughter calls out for him to stop, but he does not stop, and the three daughters run after him in a field.

s.t: A parson stood in the field near the road.
s.fr: Un pasteur se tenait dans le champ près de la route.

s.t: He saw the three daughters running and stuck together.
s.fr: Il vit les trois filles courir et rester collées ensemble.

s.t: "Why are you running after that young man?" the parson asked.
s.fr: « Pourquoi courez-vous après ce jeune homme ? » dit le pasteur.

s.t: "You must stop now!" he said.
s.fr: « Vous devez vous arrêter maintenant ! » dit-il.

paras.summary: A parson sees the three daughters running stuck together and scolds them for chasing after the young man.

s.t: The parson reached for the third daughter's hand.
s.fr: Le pasteur tendit la main vers la main de la troisième fille.

s.t: He wanted to pull her from the road.
s.fr: Il voulait la tirer hors de la route.

s.t: His hand stuck fast to her hand too.
s.fr: Sa main resta collée à sa main à elle aussi.

paras.summary: He reaches for the third daughter's hand to pull her away, but his hand sticks fast to hers too, so he must run too.

s.t: A sexton saw the parson running down the road.
s.fr: Un sacristain vit le pasteur courir sur la route.

s.t: "Where are you running to?" the sexton called.
s.fr: « Où courez-vous ainsi ? » appela le sacristain.

s.t: "The church needs you now!" the sexton said.
s.fr: « L’église a besoin de vous maintenant ! » dit le sacristain.

s.t: He took hold of the parson.
s.fr: Il saisit le pasteur.

s.t: He stuck fast too.
s.fr: Il resta collé lui aussi.

s.t: Five people ran behind the goose in a line.
s.fr: Cinq personnes coururent derrière l’oie en file.

paras.summary: A sexton sees the parson running and calls out that the church needs him, then takes hold of him and sticks fast too, so five people now run behind the goose in a line.

s.t: A king and his young daughter lived in the city.
s.fr: Un roi et sa jeune fille vivaient dans la ville.

s.t: His daughter was a young princess who never laughed.
s.fr: Sa fille était une jeune princesse qui ne riait jamais.

s.t: The king wanted the princess to laugh.
s.fr: Le roi voulait que la princesse rie.

s.t: "Whoever makes the young princess laugh will marry her," said the king.
s.fr: « Celui qui fera rire la jeune princesse l’épousera », dit-il le roi.

s.t: Many people in the city wanted to make her laugh.
s.fr: Beaucoup de gens dans la ville voulaient la faire rire.

s.t: But no man in the city could make the princess laugh.
s.fr: Mais aucun homme dans la ville ne pouvait faire rire la princesse.

paras.summary: A king's daughter is a young princess who has never laughed, and though the king wants her to laugh and has promised that whoever makes her laugh may marry her, many people in the city have wanted to make her laugh, but no man has done it.

s.t: The youngest son and his golden goose came near the city.
s.fr: Le fils cadet et son oie dorée approchèrent de la ville.

s.t: Five people still ran behind him and the goose, stuck fast.
s.fr: Cinq personnes couraient encore derrière lui et l’oie, collées solidement.

s.t: The young princess sat at her window.
s.fr: La jeune princesse était assise à sa fenêtre.

s.t: She heard a strange noise near the window.
s.fr: Elle entendit un bruit étrange près de la fenêtre.

s.t: She looked out of her window.
s.fr: Elle regarda par sa fenêtre.

paras.summary: The youngest son and his golden goose come near the city, and he walks toward it with the five people still stuck behind him, and the princess, sitting at her window, hears a strange noise and looks out.

s.t: The princess saw the youngest son and his golden goose.
s.fr: La princesse vit le fils cadet et son oie dorée.

s.t: Behind him ran five people, all stuck fast together.
s.fr: Derrière lui couraient cinq personnes, toutes collées ensemble.

s.t: The parson and the sexton ran and fell down.
s.fr: Le pasteur et le sacristain coururent et tombèrent.

s.t: The three daughters pulled them back up.
s.fr: Les trois filles les tirèrent vers le haut.

paras.summary: The princess sees the youngest son and his golden goose, with five people stuck fast behind him, and the parson and the sexton run and fall down before the three daughters pull them back up.

s.t: The princess saw this strange thing and laughed.
s.fr: La princesse vit cette chose étrange et rit.

s.t: She laughed and laughed and could not stop.
s.fr: Elle rit et rit et ne put s’arrêter.

s.t: Everyone in the city heard the princess laugh.
s.fr: Tout le monde dans la ville entendit rire la princesse.

s.t: As soon as the princess laughed, the five people came free.
s.fr: Dès que la princesse rit, les cinq personnes furent libres.

s.t: The parson, the sexton, and the three daughters went home.
s.fr: Le pasteur, le sacristain et les trois filles rentrèrent chez eux.

s.t: A servant ran to the king.
s.fr: Un serviteur courut vers le roi.

s.t: "The princess laughed!" the servant said.
s.fr: « La princesse a ri ! » dit-il le serviteur.

paras.summary: The princess laughs at the strange thing she sees and cannot stop, and as soon as she laughs, the five people come free and go home, while a servant runs to the king and says the princess laughed.

s.t: The king came out to see the youngest son.
s.fr: Le roi sortit pour voir le fils cadet.

s.t: He saw the golden goose under the youngest son's arm.
s.fr: Il vit l’oie dorée sous le bras du fils le plus jeune.

s.t: The king did not want his daughter to marry him.
s.fr: Le roi ne voulait pas que sa fille l’épouse.

s.t: "You must do one more thing first," said the king.
s.fr: « Tu dois d’abord faire une chose de plus, » dit le roi.

s.t: "Bring me a man who is never full."
s.fr: « Amenez-moi un homme qui n’est jamais rassasié. »

s.t: "He must eat and eat and never stop."
s.fr: « Il doit manger et manger et ne jamais s’arrêter. »

paras.summary: The king is glad his daughter has laughed but does not want her to marry the youngest son, so he says he must first bring a man who never stops eating.

s.t: The youngest son walked back into the forest.
s.fr: Le fils le plus jeune retourna dans la forêt.

s.t: He looked for the gray man among the trees.
s.fr: Il chercha l’homme gris parmi les arbres.

s.t: Soon he found the gray man again.
s.fr: Bientôt il trouva de nouveau l’homme gris.

s.t: "I need a man who eats and eats," said the youngest son.
s.fr: « J’ai besoin d’un homme qui mange et mange, » dit le fils le plus jeune.

paras.summary: The youngest son goes back to the forest, finds the gray man, and tells him about the king's task.

s.t: "I will do this myself," said the gray man.
s.fr: « Je ferai cela moi-même, » dit l’homme gris.

s.t: "You shared your food with me before," he said.
s.fr: « Tu as partagé ta nourriture avec moi avant, » dit-il.

s.t: The gray man walked with the youngest son to the palace.
s.fr: L’homme gris marcha avec le fils le plus jeune jusqu’au palais.

s.t: At the palace, he ate and ate and never stopped.
s.fr: Au palais, il mangea et mangea et ne s’arrêta jamais.

paras.summary: The gray man agrees to do it himself, since the youngest son once shared his food with him, and walks with him to the palace, where he eats without stopping.

s.t: The king was surprised.
s.fr: Le roi fut surpris.

s.t: "You have done what I asked," said the king.
s.fr: « Vous avez fait ce que je demandais, » dit-il le roi.

s.t: "Now you may marry my daughter."
s.fr: « Maintenant vous pouvez épouser ma fille. »

s.t: Soon the youngest son and the princess would marry.
s.fr: Bientôt le fils cadet et la princesse allaient se marier.

paras.summary: The king is surprised and says the youngest son has done what he asked, so he may now marry his daughter.

s.t: The wedding was at the king's palace.
s.fr: Le mariage eut lieu au palais du roi.

paras.summary: The wedding is held at the king's palace.

s.t: The golden goose lived with the youngest son.
s.fr: L’oie dorée vécut avec le fils cadet.

s.t: The youngest son became king one day.
s.fr: Le fils cadet devint roi un jour.

paras.summary: The golden goose stays with the youngest son, who becomes king one day.
